name: Nawab Salimullah
contribution: Salimullah supported the new province of Eastern Bengal and Assam and became an important patron of Muslim political organization in Dhaka after partition.
context: Dhaka and provincial politics in the years after 1905.
impact: His position illustrates how the partition also opened political opportunities for sections of Bengal's Muslim elite and shaped later representation debates.
highlight: Nawab Salimullah supported the new Eastern Bengal and Assam province and patronized Muslim political organization in Dhaka after 1905.
seoTitle: Nawab Salimullah: Dhaka Politics after the 1905 Partition
seoDescription: Learn about Nawab Salimullah's support for Eastern Bengal and Assam and his political patronage in Dhaka after the 1905 partition.
shortAnswer: Nawab Salimullah was the Dhaka Nawab who supported Eastern Bengal and Assam and backed Muslim political organization after 1905.
